caption: Dwingelderveld, Dwingeloo
composition: Late-September heath, faded ling, juniper, and pines · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the Dwingelderveld heath between Dwingeloo and Ruinen, a sand path crosses open heath at the end of September. The ling is mostly rust-brown, with only dull leftover mauve, and juniper and Scots pines edge the view. The sky is partly cloudy, about 10.9°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h. Sunset was 19:23. There is no August purple carpet and no snow.
